Triage: lands in `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` (`STATUS_FIELD_NAMES` ~L982 and the destructive `boolean-warning-badge` branch ~L1061); rationale: transferred from objectstack (rule 1: the body stands without objectstack). A name heuristic (`active`, `enabled`, `verified`, …) turns a plain `false` into a red "<label> — 已关闭" badge. Drop the name heuristic for plain booleans or let metadata opt in; a `false` should read as neutral.
